svg.aria-label: A large oil barrel representing about 8.4 billion barrels of total global oil inventories in early 2026, per JPMorgan. Only a thin slice at the bottom, about 0.8 billion barrels or roughly 9.5 percent, could be drawn without operational stress; by April 23 about 0.5 billion of that remained. A separate note says Aramco CEO Amin Nasser on October 5 put commercial inventories at under 6 billion barrels, most not practically available, which is a different measure and is not drawn on the barrel.
svg.text: The barrel is mostly not spendable — global oil inventories, JPMorgan's early-2026 view
